stage_c_cost.assumptions: Serial GPU; baseline context medians equally weighted; linear W times total projection time; measurement time 1 is a costing assumption. Cadence, batching, cache and ancestry can violate scaling. Upper combined setting is a stress envelope, not a dispatch choice.
stage_c_cost.exclusions: Additional four-disorder screening, stress/remaining field contexts, extra repeats, equal-cost runs, further precision checks and final surveys.
